_comment: In-house survey team. Hand-maintained — there is no Salesforce object for it. `skills` is an open attribute list: today it only records constraints, and nothing on the Resource page divides capacity by it yet (Doug, 2026-08-25: keep it as the start of a list, do not model it). `off` is days not worked, which is what drives daysAvailable. Capacity knobs left absent fall back to DEFAULT_SURVEYOR in lib/coverage.cjs.
